policy: The five endpoints whose public discovery surfaces are captured under this directory, so `--offline --fixtures tests/fixtures` grades a complete registry rather than a registry of missing files. Entries are copied verbatim from data/registry.json, including the verification records, because a fixture registry that drifted from the real one would demo something this project does not publish. Three answered when they were captured and two did not: an offline set where everything answers cannot exercise the unreachable path, which is how a published `reachability_score: 0` survived on 14 live endpoints (#135, #137).

endpoints.name: Aspirus Health Plan Patient Access API

verification.method: base URL read verbatim from servers[0].url of the OpenAPI 3.0.1 document published anonymously by Aspirus Health Plan's own branded developer portal, which the plan links from https://www.aspirushealthplan.com/insurance/Interoperability/ under 'Developers'. Catalog entry id 'patient-access'
verification.observed: no answer to an unauthenticated GET of /metadata on 2026-09-04. The host resolves; the sibling portal host presents an incomplete TLS chain, which is the likeliest cause

endpoints.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona Patient Access API

verification.method: base URL printed verbatim on the plan's own page at azblue.com/interoperability, section 'For App Developers': 'The base URL for our APIs is https://azblue.innovaccer.com/fhir/'. Vendor is Innovaccer; the plan prints the finished address itself rather than pointing at a template
verification.observed: HTTP 403 to an unauthenticated GET of /metadata on 2026-09-04. The address is published without qualification, so what this records is that a stranger following the plan's own instructions retrieves no conformance document. No Provider Directory base URL is published anywhere on the site, although the same page asserts the capability

verification.method: live CapabilityStatement fetch; publisher confirmed via implementation description 'gov.cms.bfd:bfd-server-war' and software 'Blue Button API'
